templates.thank_you_general: Thanks for taking a look at AEGIS-DocIntel! Let me know if you run into any formatting or table issues on your documents.
templates.technical_architecture: Great question! Standard tools flatten PDFs into flat text, whereas AEGIS extracts spatial bounding boxes and sorts them with a Kahn DAG before submodular knapsack context packing.
templates.privacy_question: Your uploads are strictly isolated and never used for model training under our provider and architecture agreements.
